name: NYPL Teen Curators Program
what_you_do: Meet twice a week after school at the Library. You learn from expert curators, study items in a current exhibition, and make your own digital media in response to it.
who_can_apply: Students in 11th or 12th grade who live or go to school in New York City.
pay_detail: Stipend. The page does not state the amount.
duration: About 9 weeks. In 2026 it ran Oct 20 to Dec 17, Tuesdays and Thursdays 4:30 to 6 PM, at the Schwarzman Building and the Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 application closed Sept 20, 2026. Teens were told Oct 2 and orientation was Oct 17. The next cycle is not posted.
how_to_apply: Online application on the program page when it is open. Selected teens are notified by email.
notes: The theme changes with each exhibition. The fall 2026 group studied the Declaration of Independence. Sign up for NYPL's teen newsletter to hear when the next application opens.
